text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal. I've placed the 
dishes... in the return slot.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~~. I made too much rice, so you 
really saved me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there weren't many students today. 
Now then, what to do with the leftovers...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll partake.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Wait, all of it!? There's still quite a 
bit left, you know? Are you sure you're 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was running late due to work. I checked 
the cafeteria to see if I could grab a 
bite before heading home."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And there was Admire Groove, standing 
before a massive spread of food!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Alv, what's with all that food?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"……I'll burn off everything I consumed 
through exercise. So there is no problem."
choice_data_list: Even so, it's not good for you!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer! That is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to prevent food waste…… I can 
understand that feeling. In this 
situation――
choice_data_list:
As long as you don't push yourself too 
hard, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to prevent food waste…… I can 
understand that feeling. In this 
situation――
choice_data_list:
As long as you don't push yourself too 
hard, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Why are you...?
choice_data_list:
Because I can't let you push yourself too 
hard.

Because I can't let you do anything 
reckless.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You always say things like that...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Please, take as much as you want to 
eat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By dividing the work between the two of 
us, we managed to stop Admire Groove from 
overeating!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...That is my intention. From the very 
beginning."

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
"Don't push yourself too hard, okay? Just 
knowing you care makes me so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Admire Groove ended up eating far 
more than usual.
